WHEREAS, the increase in Laramie County's share and WCIl's share of the costs of
construction of the Polk Avenue Project will likely exceed the maximums provided for in City
Contract No.'s 6134 and 6135.
1.The contract price to be paid by the City to Reiman pursuant to City Contract No.
6137 shall be increased by the sum of $107,505.38.
2.The Board of County Commissioners of Laramie County, Wyoming, will reimburse
the City for Laramie County's share ofthe increased contract price in the amount of$45,943.24 and,
to the extent that this reimbursement exceeds the maximum contribution to be paid by Laramie
County under City Contract No.6134, said contract is hereby amended to require Laramie County
to pay its portion of the construction costs of the Polk Avenue Project as specified herein.
3.WCII will reimburse the City for WC Il's share of the increased contract price in the
amount of $9,027.39 and, to the extent that this reimbursement exceeds the maximum contribution
to be paid byWCII under City Contract No.6135, said contract is hereby amended to requireWCII
to pay its portion of the construction costs of the Polk Avenue Project as specified herein.Unless
otherwise agreed in writing, WCllI shall not be obligated to reimburse the City for project cost
overruns which exceed the limits specified in City Contract No.6135orin this amendment tosaid
contract.
4.WCII will remove all piles oftop soil and overburden which have been placed on the
property of WCll in the area between Polk Avenue and the temporary construction access point to
the property of W ClI from Pershing Boulevard, except that the City and its contractors shall have
the right, before June 30,2015, to access and remove top soilas needed to complete punch list items.
Neither the City nor its contractors shall add, nor permit others to add, any top soil or overburden
to the existing piles.
5.All terms and conditions of City Contract No.'s 6134,6135, and 6137 shall remain
infull force and effect except asmodified by this Amendment.
6.This Amendment shall become effective when it has been duly executed by
authorized representatives of theparties to this Amendment.
